admission.justification: Realized across state_conversion.py, knowledge.py, classify.py, reconsideration.py, and touched_records.py, proved by seven regression functions in test_state_conversion_worklist.py, and prevents the worklist gate from opening a wall of conversion-only items when users run knowledge-convert-states.

applicability: Knowledge-worklist record-file change detection across knowledge_changes, _Evaluation._record_file_trigger, and touched_record_items when comparing a canonical base memory tree with a candidate memory tree.
conditions: Base and candidate record files are valid UTF-8 JSON objects and the base text equals canonical_text(base).

Only the conversion's two edits are permitted: removing a status key in LEGACY_STATE_WORDS and, where base lacks writer, adding a WriterStamp-validated writer object, yielding exact canonical_text(expected) bytes equal to candidate.
KnowledgeSide.record_file_changed still treats absent or moved records as changed, and touched_record_items still treats changed, added, or removed Markdown sidecars as changed.
exclusions: Non-legacy status edits, modifications or removals of an existing writer stamp, formatting-only or non-canonical edits, and any other field edits still count as changed.
knowledge_gate/landing.py dependent movement scans, _raise_mark_only, and deferral-only dependent classification remain outside this exemption.
statement: A record file whose candidate JSON differs from its canonical base only by state-conversion edits (legacy status word removed and a valid writer stamp added where absent, rendered canonically) counts as untouched at knowledge_changes, _record_file_trigger, and touched_record_items, while moved records, changed Markdown sidecars, non-legacy status edits, writer changes, formatting-only edits, and absent records still raise.
title: State-conversion-only diffs count as untouched in the knowledge worklist
